Quests.Title: A Reserve for the Block
Quests.Summary: An optional paid maintenance chain. Enter Cinder Dispatch, compare two real receivers, isolate the cracked feed and secure a clean crystal reserve. It opens after the first Underheart job and does not replace the story.
Quests.Done: Reserve isolated. Tamsin Reyes at the Pressure House can use the readings to stabilize the block. Your payment is recorded once for this completed contract.

Steps.Objective: Enter Cinder Dispatch through its real front door and reach the indoor marker.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to read the stable receiver
Steps.Objective: Inside Dispatch, read the stable receiver on the left bench.

Lines.Speaker: Receiver A
Lines.Text: Clean pulse, no leakage. This is the safe pattern for the neighborhood reserve.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to isolate the damaged feed
Steps.Objective: Isolate the damaged feed at receiver B before collecting its reserve.

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: The cracked feed would drain a focus. Isolate it first; do not solve a maintenance fault by firing at it.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to secure the reserve by hand
Steps.Objective: Secure the indoor reserve: stay at the fitting bench for five seconds, or ask your companion to assist.
Steps.Text: The reserve is isolated. Your own charge, flight energy and stamina are separate resources.

Steps.Objective: Report the completed work to Corin Pell.

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: Reserve isolated. Tamsin Reyes at the Pressure House can use the readings to stabilize the block. Your payment is recorded once for this completed contract.

Steps.Objective: Leave through the front door. The contract pays after a safe exit.

Quests.Entrance: Cinder Dispatch front door, across Veyra Avenue from the Veyra Lofts

Quests.Title: Room to Breathe
Quests.Summary: Follow Dispatch's readings into the Pressure House. Check the indoor fuse cabinet, stabilize the vent valve and inspect the nest without harming its occupants. A hand-tool alternative works without a bonded creature.
Quests.Done: Pressure is steady. Take the readings to Dante Rook at his forge in Old Silver for the final tempering job. The nest and the Underheart story remain intact.

Steps.Objective: Enter the Pressure House through its real front door and reach the indoor marker.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to compare the reserve readings
Steps.Objective: Compare Dispatch's reserve readings with the indoor fuse cabinet.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: A second feed was pulling against the first. Read the cabinet, then hold the valve steady. The stair stays clear.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to stabilize the valve by hand
Steps.Objective: Stabilize the indoor vent valve for six seconds, or let a companion find the safe setting.
Steps.Text: The valve settles. No guards, reinforcements or doorway barriers are spawned by this job.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to check the nest from a safe distance
Steps.Objective: Check the existing indoor nest. Do not attack the hatchlings.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: No fresh scorch marks. The warm air is moving past them now. I will leave them to Tamsin.

Steps.Objective: Report the completed work to Tamsin Reyes.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: Pressure is steady. Take the readings to Dante Rook at his forge in Old Silver for the final tempering job. The nest and the Underheart story remain intact.

Steps.Objective: Leave through the front door. The contract pays after a safe exit.

Quests.Entrance: Pressure House front door, beside the warm conduit

Quests.Title: A Steady Temper
Quests.Summary: Enter Dante Rook's existing forge in Old Silver. Inspect a practice blank, hold the repair bench steady and seal the finished reserve. Earn crafting stock, then choose story, a nearby contract, recharging or the companion rescue lead.
Quests.Done: Reserve sealed. The block has a quiet workroom again. Keep the earned stock for real Forge recipes, or follow the story toward Odile and the drakeling rescue. This job never grants a companion.

Steps.Objective: Enter Dante Rook's forge through its real front door and reach the indoor marker.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to inspect the practice blank
Steps.Objective: Inspect the practice blank at the marked indoor forge worktable.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: The edge matters as much as the light. A blade keeps working when the focus runs dry. These readings tell us how to temper a reserve without cracking it.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to hold the temper steady by hand
Steps.Objective: Keep the forge temper steady for seven seconds, or use your companion's assist.
Steps.Text: The reserve holds its temper. Only the completed contract pays materials; repeating a work step pays nothing.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to seal the tempered reserve
Steps.Objective: Seal the tempered reserve at the indoor worktable.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Done. Keep your crystal stock for the Forge. Change your build at the fitting bench whenever you want; learning a blade does not lock you out of focus or ward.

Steps.Objective: Report the completed work to Dante Rook.

Lines.Speaker: Dante Rook
Lines.Text: Reserve sealed. The block has a quiet workroom again. Keep the earned stock for real Forge recipes, or follow the story toward Odile and the drakeling rescue. This job never grants a companion.

Steps.Objective: Leave through the front door. The contract pays after a safe exit.

Quests.Floor: Dante Rook's forge, ground-floor repair room
Quests.Entrance: Dante Rook's existing forge front door in Old Silver
